summary: Frontend-only regression of the chat-screen split (app/(tabs)/index.tsx 3979 -> 2674 lines into src/chat/*) and the three Family Journey copy fixes. Static check: the new index.tsx differs from HEAD only by removed blocks (old lines 43-53, 58-394, 3015-3979) plus new imports. The moved StyleSheet matches the old one byte for byte, and every moved helper or component matches apart from the 'export' keyword and comment placement. tsc reports no errors in index.tsx or src/chat/*. The only declarations that disappeared, BASIC_SUGGESTIONS and PRO_SUGGESTIONS, were unused in the old file. UI checks at 375x667 with a seeded login all passed: chat styles render correctly; the 4 generic suggestion chips show and tapping one sends it; 'What is Article 21?' streams an answer with follow-up chips; View/Hide Legal Details shows and hides the citation card (Article 21, stale-date warning); the SOS banner appears after 'help me' and its 112/1091/100 buttons and dismiss work; the guest 'In an emergency, call' 112/181 shortcut renders and is tappable; 'help me file an FIR' shows the Start Guided FIR Draft button, which opens /fir-draft; New Chat sends a fresh session_id while follow-ups reuse the server id; Rights -> 'Ask Dhara more' (arrest) shows the 4 arrest chips instead of the generic ones. The IPC migration notice was checked with a mocked stream response, because the real backend refuses IPC questions and returns no citation. The guest shortcut was checked by overriding the stored user on the client. Copy fixes: all 3 verified exactly. No browser console errors and no red or blank screens.

minor.issue: 'What is IPC section 420?', 'What does Section 302 of the Indian Penal Code say?' and 'What is Article 14?' all return 'I cannot confirm this from the official text. Please consult an advocate.' with no citation. As a result, the IPC migration notice cannot appear with real data. This is a content/registry gap, not caused by the refactor.

The final answer for Article 21 begins 'Answer:\nthis constitutional right…' with a lowercase first word after the 'Answer:' heading. This is cosmetic LLM/post-processing output, not caused by the refactor.

issues: The DHARA-B019 IPC migration notice (ipc-notice-<key>) only renders after 'View Legal Details' is expanded. No notice shows in the collapsed state. The same behaviour exists in the pre-split HEAD code, so this is not a regression, but it contradicts the B019 code comment ('visible on render, not only when expanded').

action_items: Optional: decide whether the IPC migration notice must show while legal details are collapsed (per the B019 comment). If so, render a compact notice next to the verdict when any citation passes isIpcCitation.
Optional: the code comment at app/settings/data-privacy.tsx:285 still says '(Phase 1: preview only)'. It is not shown to users, but it is out of date.

Optional: the Expo SSR log has a 'Unexpected text node: . A text node cannot be a child of a <View>' error from some route (it does not appear in the browser console). Worth finding the stray whitespace or '.' child.
critical_code_review_comments: The refactor is a pure move: diff vs HEAD shows only removals plus import lines, chatStyles.ts matches the old StyleSheet exactly, and EmergencyBanners.tsx uses inline styles with its own theme/openExternal imports.
The openExternal import was correctly dropped from index.tsx (tsc reports no unresolved names there).
index.tsx is still 2674 lines (well above the 700-line guideline). Splitting it further, e.g. the voice/recording handlers and the message-bubble renderer, would help maintainability.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (all 8 requested items passed; IPC notice and guest shortcut checked with mocked/overridden state)

seed_data_creation: None. Chat sessions were created for voicetest2026@example.com by the normal chat flow (Article 21/14, IPC 420/302, 'help me', FIR, arrest questions). No users were created and no settings were changed.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Use the seeded-localStorage login (tests/family_journey_ui_test.py SEED_AUTH_JS) from /language. Deep-linking to '/' redirects to /home, so reach chat via home-type-button or /rights ask-more-<id>.
